contracts.name: Policy Registry Only
contracts.rule: The Task Group Registry classifies work and constrains eligibility. It MUST NOT store task instances, own workflow lifecycle, grant authority, allocate resources, route physical models, execute effects or attest evidence.

contracts.name: Exactly 31 First-Level Groups
contracts.rule: The canonical registry MUST contain exactly F01 through F31 as unique first-level task groups.

contracts.name: Temporal Exclusivity
contracts.rule: F07 Durable Workflow Lifecycle is Temporal-exclusive. Conductor or another specialist MUST NOT become global durable lifecycle owner.

contracts.name: Horizontal Authority Isolation
contracts.rule: F09 through F13 are horizontal authority/service domains. Orchestration MAY request their decisions but MUST NOT project them as specialist authority.

contracts.name: Independent Verification
contracts.rule: F17 Verification & Evidence remains independent from the executor; worker output is a claim until Evidence/Gate verification.

contracts.name: Monotonic Scope
contracts.rule: Task-group policy MAY narrow eligibility and scope but MUST NOT widen user, application, role, task, security, runtime or authority scope.

contracts.name: Workload Mode Boundary
contracts.rule: Task-group policy MAY declare Workload Mode intent/domain hints but MUST NOT mutate physical resources. With FA3 present, HRB remains exclusive resource admission, placement, reservation and lease authority.

contracts.name: CPU-Only Validity
contracts.rule: Task-group policy MUST preserve CPU-only viability and zero-to-N accelerator cardinality unless an individual admitted workload explicitly requires otherwise.

contracts.name: No Display-GPU Auto Recruitment
contracts.rule: Task-group policy MUST NOT automatically recruit the display GPU for AI execution when another GPU or NPU exists; any exception remains subject to the existing manual selection rule.

contracts.name: Blueprint Binding
contracts.rule: Every Agent/Application Blueprint task_group_id MUST resolve to a canonical task-group ID or registered compatibility alias, and compilation MUST bind canonical ID, revision and digest.

contracts.name: No Runtime Promotion
contracts.rule: Task-group policy, registry presence or static guard PASS MUST NOT promote a provider/runtime or manufacture Current Host evidence.
